title: The Cold War - OverSimplified (Part 1)
beats: Lenin sent by Germany to Russia, with the Lennon/Lenin mix-up gag
Lenin's rule compressed to a list; deathbed joke sets up Stalin
Stalin rises, Five-Year Plans, terror; WWII squeezed into one sentence
Yalta-era allies: Stalin's mood, atomic bomb reveal, spies
NordVPN sponsor read tied to the spy joke
Bomb ends WWII; 'free and fair elections' in Eastern Europe played as ironic dialogue; Iron Curtain
Greece, Turkey, Iran, NATO, Truman Doctrine as the official start
Marshall Plan vs COMECON/COMINFORM framed as an economic battle
Berlin as the sharpest case: East Berliners seeing the West framed as a cheating-spouse sketch
Berlin blockade and airlift, Soviet bomb ends US monopoly
China's communist victory, Korea divided and war
Seoul changing hands ruthless-dictator-after-dictator; MacArthur and the nuke argument
Stalin's death, de-Stalinization, Hungary/East Germany/Poland crushed, bans from personal taste
Spying, Red Scare, U-2 incident, space race, Nixon exhibit
Warsaw Pact, Kennedy elected, why Berlin hurts the East: defection
Replay Kennedy's 'East Berlin is yours' line, spot the slip; Wall built
Checkpoint Charlie standoff resolved by inching tanks back; 'it wasn't the biggest crisis'

new_moves.name: replay-and-spot-the-flaw
new_moves.what: Rewinds a scene and asks the viewer to find the mistake that explains what follows
new_moves.evidence: 13:57 'Did you catch that? Let's replay it'

new_moves.name: recurring-pressure-point
new_moves.what: Returns to one city three times, each pass adding stakes, so the climax feels earned

new_moves.name: ironic-dialogue-for-lies
new_moves.what: Repeated sarcastic assurance to show a promise is hollow

theory: The video turns abstract geopolitics into one competition and returns to Berlin as the concrete pressure point, so the climax is understood before it happens. The replay at 13:57 invites the viewer to find the cause themselves. Humor carries the load, but the structure is recurring case plus callback.
velocity: Orchestrator: revisit one concrete case at rising stakes instead of introducing a new example each time
Scene builder: support a 'replay and find the slip' scene where a tutor rewinds a step
Voice: sarcasm to expose hollow promises needs flagging so a literal learner is not misled
Ghost hands: repeat a motion step by step (tank inching) to show de-escalation
Evals: test whether the learner predicts the Wall before it appears
